name: Betfred
observations: Large blue/yellow/red fascia with white BETFRED wording and bonus-king text.
Red-framed lower glazed door/window bays and large promotional poster panels.
Upper pale/cream facade has a decorative shaped pediment/roof edge and small windows, distinct from Costa brick mass.
Entry has a shallow recess and reddish threshold/apron.
Do not use current betting promotion wording as permanent geometry; sign layers can change independently.
